description: Quarterly lubrication service completed. Lubricant replaced with specified grade. No abnormality reported.
Suction strainer found fouled during routine check. Strainer removed, cleaned and refitted. Suction pressure returned to the usual range after cleaning.
Drive-end bearing replaced. Replacement bearing fitted to specification and running checks completed.
Coupling alignment performed. Alignment brought within the vendor tolerance and recorded.
Suction strainer inspection. Partial fouling noted on the strainer element. Strainer cleaned and refitted. Second occurrence of strainer fouling recorded for this asset.
Lubrication service completed and oil sample taken. Oil analysis report returned within normal range; no wear-metal exception raised.
Drive-end bearing temperature investigated following a console observation. Lubrication corrected. See WO-7712 for the full work-order record and findings.
Mechanical inspection request raised following a vibration observation on the unit. Inspection scope to be determined by the maintenance planner. Work not yet carried out.
Standby pump availability check completed. Pump turned over and confirmed available for service.
